title: Issue
description: Structured issue write-up produced by the issue-writeup skill. Foundational primitive consumed by exception-analysis (compliance-testing), audit findings, regulator-response files, the issue log, risk-committee-pack, and control-matrix (open-issue links). Stable contract: additive changes only between minor versions; breaking changes ship as a versioned migration.

issue_id.description: Stable identifier for this issue. Reused across revisions of the same issue.

title.description: One-line title; reads as the issue, not as the cause.

engagement_id.description: Foreign key into scope.schema.json when the write-up was built under a formal scope.

as_of_date.description: Date this revision of the write-up was authored.

status.description: Lifecycle status. The skill emits draft or under-review; downstream remediation tracking moves the issue through the rest.

source_type.description: What confirmed the condition. The source type drives the severity calibration ladder, the reviewer machinery, and whether the MRA / MRIA classification field is required.

source_id.description: Audit engagement ID, exam letter ID, control-test workpaper ID, vendor monitoring record ID, validation report ID, or other source identifier.

regulator.description: When source_type is examiner-letter: the regulator that issued the matter (FRB, OCC, FDIC, SEC, FINRA, CFPB, NYDFS, state DOI, NAIC, FinCEN, OFAC, other).

date_identified.description: Date the condition was first identified by the source.

period_start.description: Start of the period the condition covers.

period_end.description: End of the period the condition covers.

condition.description: The dated, scoped, observable state. Not a conclusion ('the control failed'). Not commentary ('oversight is weak'). Specific. Quantified where possible.

criteria.description: Named source with section. Multiple criteria can be concatenated with explicit separation; the criteria_source_anchor field carries the path back to references/source-anchors.md or the loaded overlay.

criteria_source_anchor.description: Path to the source-anchors entry, sector overlay, cross-cutting overlay, or firm-overlay that holds the citation and excerpt for the criteria. Example: 'references/source-anchors.md#bcbs-239'.

cause.description: Root cause, tied to a specific control design or operation weakness. Names the control attribute that failed. 'Human error' / 'training gap' / 'system limitation' are surface labels and not acceptable as the cause field; the cause is what is underneath them. Where root cause analysis is genuinely pending, the field reads 'root cause analysis pending' and the issue carries an open action.

impact.description: The effect / impact, quantified where possible. Financial, customer, regulatory, operational, reputational. Carries the unit and the time window.

severity.description: Severity rating. Always paired with severity_rationale. Severity assignment carries human review; the skill does not assign severity unilaterally.

severity_rationale.description: Rationale for the severity rating. References materiality (against firm thresholds where they exist), frequency, customer impact, regulatory exposure, and any compensating controls in place.

compensating_controls.description: Compensating controls in place that affect the severity rating. Empty array when none.

mra_mria_classification.description: Required when source_type is examiner-letter. n/a otherwise. MRA = Matter Requiring Attention (FRB, OCC). MRIA = Matter Requiring Immediate Attention (FRB). MRBA = Matter Requiring Board Attention (FDIC).

population_size.description: Population size when the issue arose from a sample-based test.

sample_size.description: Sample size when the issue arose from a sample-based test.

projected_exception_rate.description: Projected exception rate as a decimal (0.05 = 5%). Omit when the firm does not project from this sample.

sampling_methodology.description: Sampling methodology used by the upstream test.

recommendation.description: Declarative voice. What the owner must do. Specific enough that closure is testable.

remediation.description: Free-text remediation summary. Carries the high-level plan; the structured fields below carry the testable elements.

owner.description: Named role with accountability. Not a team. Not a person (the role outlives the incumbent). Where the role taxonomy is firm-specific, it comes from references/firm-overlay.md.

target_date.description: Target closure date. Where remediation runs longer than 90 days, milestones go in remediation_milestones.

remediation_milestones.description: Interim milestones for remediation runs longer than 90 days.

closure_evidence.description: The artifacts the firm will inspect to confirm closure. System name, report ID, sign-off log path, reconciliation evidence, etc. 'Remediated' is not closure evidence; closure evidence is the artifact, not the verb.

interim_mitigation.description: Manual workaround or compensating control in flight while the structural fix is built. Empty when none.

evidence_gap.description: Yes when the write-up has gaps in evidence (population partially inspected, criteria not fully cited, root cause pending). Routes to the engagement issue log.

evidence_gap_note.description: One-line description of the evidence gap when evidence_gap is true.

confidence_label.description: Author's confidence in the write-up as a whole. Reflects source posture, evidence depth, and how settled the cause analysis is.

reviewer_questions.description: Questions for the human reviewer at sign-off. Specific to this issue; tied to elements of the CCCE; not generic ('is this fit for purpose').

human_review_required.description: Always true. The skill stops at draft; severity assignment always carries human review.

revisions.description: Append-only revision log. Every material refresh of the write-up lands a row.
